commitments.claim: AutogradContext is an immutable Copy value. recording() permits eligible graph recording, no_grad() forbids new operation edges, and Default selects recording().
commitments.limitations: The context controls operations created with it; it is not a mutable model mode and does not detach an existing TensorValue.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners know that reverse-mode nodes may retain parent edges.

commitments.claim: A new result tracks gradients only when its context permits recording and at least one parent tracks gradients. Finite checking occurs before that decision; no_grad clears the new node's parent edges. recording over only constants remains untracked.
commitments.limitations: A recording context may retain parent edges even when every parent is untracked; the conjunction determines tracks_gradient, not whether recording-context parents are stored.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners distinguish a node's tracking flag from the context policy.

commitments.claim: No-gradient operations still execute arithmetic, shape validation, and finite-result checks; their result is untracked, has one-node topology, rejects backward, and does not clear or alter existing parameter gradients. zero_grad is the separate gradient-clearing operation.
commitments.limitations: This claim concerns newly created nodes and existing gradient buffers, not arbitrary mutation outside the shown APIs.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners know the difference between a computation graph and stored parameter gradients.

commitments.claim: Tracked convenience APIs select recording(), while context-aware tensor, layer, attention, decoder, loss, evaluation, generation, checkpoint, and pipeline paths propagate the caller-selected context through child operations. Calls can interleave without ambient-state restoration or leakage.
commitments.limitations: AutogradContext is Copy, so 'same context' means the same immutable selected policy value, not object identity.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners can follow parent-to-child function arguments.

commitments.claim: evaluate_no_grad creates one no-gradient context before its epoch loop, passes it into DecoderModel::loss_with_context, checks every batch loss is untracked, computes one token-weighted epoch mean, and verifies parameter-gradient bits are unchanged.
commitments.limitations: The evaluator accepts the partition policy enforced by its caller; the statement about untracked values is specifically about each returned batch loss.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners understand mini-batch means and token weighting.

commitments.claim: The standalone incremental wrapper creates no_grad after request checks, while a model-wide KV session selects no_grad before embedding and passes it into the same context-aware prepared calculation.
commitments.limitations: The context-aware prepared entry is crate-private and inference-only; it is not a public training path.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners know the difference between a standalone layer call and a model-wide cached session.

commitments.claim: Incremental attention applies Q/K/V projections, head splits, and RoPE, computes raw-tensor weights of shape [B,H,1,t] for the resulting prefix length t and mixes values, wraps the head output as an untracked constant, then merges heads and applies the output projection under the same no-gradient context before a later transactional cache commit.
commitments.limitations: The raw-tensor mixture is intentionally inference-only and does not claim to preserve a training graph through cached history.
commitments.prerequisite: Learners know Q, K, V, head splitting, RoPE, and the cache-length convention.
